# PhaseOrdering

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The arrangement of oscillatory phases across spatial locations at a given time or over a time window. Allows TCC and iNEST architectures to infer functional connectivity and synchronization patterns without centralized computation.
